svg.title: Tower Defense complete skill tree
svg.desc: Three upward trees. Every tree starts from its base, branches to three Tier I families, then nine Tier II skills, and finally their Tier III Ultimates.

g.text: Tower damage, firing cadence and critical conversion
TIER III — ONE ULTIMATE PER TIER-I FAMILY
TIER II — CHOOSE TWO OF THREE

text.tspan: Autonomous tower Rounds: random damage, projectile flight and base critical hits.
Tier I investments unlock the three offensive directions above.

g.text: Kethra resilience, movement and collective biomass
TIER III — ONE ULTIMATE PER TIER-I FAMILY
TIER II — CHOOSE TWO OF THREE

text.tspan: The owner’s mutation upgrades define the opponent’s Kethra at spawn.
Armor, movement and HP can stack with their Tier-II effects.

g.text: Flux flow, battlefield information and active pressure tools
TIER III — ONE ULTIMATE PER TIER-I FAMILY
TIER II — CHOOSE TWO OF THREE

text.tspan: Flux is earned from kills and Flux Yield. Core Strain is the pressure limit.
Only Surge Core can add active abilities; every other family is passive.
